criticality: All direct S/V/K8, code/config/science/official-original dependencies and declared historical references are critical, except exact tests/cases/test_* descendants predeclared noncritical. Permission denied is UNVERIFIED, never MATCH. Any readable mismatch is FAIL; critical missing/unreadable is BLOCKED. Auxiliary audit references do not replace direct evidence.

sampling.rule: No random selection: every odd-index 5s point held out from 10s proxy grids for all 28 satellites; all stored main geometry exact_states compared against production four-node 5s interpolation. All eligible points reported, never sampled by residual magnitude.
sampling.retained_proxy_evidence: Every residual persisted in per-satellite compressed NumPy arrays with exact time arrays; all exact-state residual rows persisted as JSON.

status_policy: PASS requires all engineering checks executed and passed, no native activation, raw preservation and final artifact verification. Missing critical evidence is BLOCKED; mismatch/test failure/forbidden action is FAIL. Honest EMPIRICAL_ONLY or UNRESOLVED scientific conclusions may coexist with engineering PASS. No promotion to official or search certification.
search_certification: No global completeness certification from fixed margin, node residuals, proxy-grid holdouts or event-selected exact states. Unknown bounds/interpolation failures/boundaries retain candidates or explicitly stop certification. Production code unchanged.
seal_policy: Close logs and finalize status/report before raw manifest. Artifact manifest excludes itself and post-verification only. Post-verification hashes manifest and reads all members; failures change final status/exit and require resealing. No recursive self-hash.
